run_parlai_chat_task_local: run a local inhouse ParlAI chat task demo with configurable turns and timeout
build_parlai_chat_task_demo: build the ParlAI chat task demo React app with force rebuild and post install options
configure_parlai_task: configure a ParlAI task with num_turns and turn_timeout settings via ParlAITaskConfig
launch_mephisto_task_run: launch a Mephisto task run using the operator with shared state and mephisto config
create_shared_parlai_state: create a SharedParlAITaskState with world options for conversation turns and timeout settings
